notes.title: V2.1.5 - More indepth error logging
notes.notes:
[h3]Changelog[/h3]
- Added more indepth error reporting for failed asset loads
- Fixed more potential crashes when certain assets exist but won't load. 

This version is currently only available in the beta channel

notes.title: V2.1.4 - Removed potential extra slash in file path on load
notes.notes:
[h3]Changelog[/h3]
- Removed potential for an extra slash to form in the file path when loading game assets (causing game to fail to load assets). 
- Also added more detailed error logging for the various things that can go wrong (and puts it in LogErrors.txt, which can be found in the ICommissionedSomeSeries local app folder.)

This update is currently only available on the beta channel

notes.title: V2.1.3 - Fixed crash in hash check if file fails to load
notes.notes:
[h3]Changelog[/h3]
- Fixed a bug where the game would crash if a game asset exists but failed to load. 
- It will also log any fails to LogErrors.txt in the ICommissionedSomeSeries local app data folder. 

This build is currently only available in the beta channel

notes.title: V2.1.2 - Fixed vsync and added a load log
notes.notes:
Changelog:
FIXED - Vsync not enabled
ADDED - Thumbnail file load status is logged here on game load:

...\appdata\local\ICommissionedSomeSeries\ThumbnailLoadLog.txt 

This version is currently only available on the beta branch (you'll need to switch to it within your steam client).
